study_identification_part.si_4_title: Shared differential factors underlying individual spontaneous neural activity abnormalities in major depressive disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: DIDA-MDD (Discovery dataset, multi-center); REST-meta-MDD (Validation dataset, multi-center); SALD (Single-center dataset used for structural covariance network construction)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "This study included two extensive multi-center datasets... sourced from the Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group (DIDA-MDD) and REST-meta-MDD consortium... To construct the normal SC network, we utilized another large single-center dataset (SALD)..."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Samples; Methods / Association between differential factors and normal brain network

answer.DIDA-MDD: Discovery dataset: normative training/testing (HC) and clinical application (MDD)

answer.REST-meta-MDD: Validation dataset: replication of normative training/testing (HC) and clinical application (MDD)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: DIDA-MDD was the primary dataset for discovery and initial factor analysis. REST-meta-MDD provided independent validation. SALD was used to provide a reference structural covariance network for biological interpretation of the factors.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "All analyses were initially conducted in the discovery dataset and subsequently replicated in the validation dataset... To construct the normal SC network, we utilized another large single-center dataset (SALD)..."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Han2024B.pdf.md: Methods / Samples; Methods / Association between differential factors and normal brain network

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Model-1 used 1079 HCs from DIDA-MDD. Model-2 used 1104 HCs from REST-meta-MDD. For both, the normative range was estimated based on these healthy cohorts.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "the final sample included... 1079 HCs (age: 33.96 ± 19.25 years, females: 56.81%)... comprising 25 research sites with... 1104 HCs (age: 36.15 ± 24.552 years, females: 58.06%)."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Model-1 (DIDA HC): Mean 33.96, SD 13.87 (from Table S1; main text says 19.25). Model-2 (REST HC): Mean 36.15, SD 24.55 (from main text; Table S1 typo 245.52).
